full_judgment: 2. Shortly stated facts are, that the plaintiffs opposite parties instituted the aforesaid Title Suit in the court of Senior Assistant Judge, Kashba, Brahmanbaria for a declaration that the notice dated 1-6-92 issued by the defendant No. 3 for their eviction from the suit land is illegal. The further case of the plaintiffs is that the property described in the 3 schedules of the plaint along with other lands belonged to the said opposite parties by purchase from the original landlord by a registered sale deed but those were wrongly recorded in the name of the Government in the khas khatian. The defendant Government illegally issued a notice dated 1-6-92 for evicting the plaintiffs from the suit land. Hence the suit.
